mechanism: 통화가치 절하의 변화가 해외 수요·수출 비용·시장 접근 경로를 통해 수출 판매 규모의 증가로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R00919의 적용 맥락: Using annual plant-level panel data on 62 Colombian chemical plants operating continuously during 1982–1991, this paper estimates a dynamic structural model of firms’ export participation and export revenue decisions. The institutional setting is Colombia’s trade and exchange-rate environment (real peso depreciation and export subsidy regimes) in the 1980s–early 1990s. Units are manufacturing plants; key features include firm heterogeneity in marginal costs and foreign demand, stochastic AR processes for exchange rates and profit shocks, and stochastic sunk start-up and fixed costs of exporting. The estimated model is used to simulate devaluations and subsidy policies.
